raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An eager TP all-reduce through `CustomAllReduceV2` spends about 3.8 µs in Python on top of the 5.2 µs launch, measured on H200 (x86) with #44251 applied. The cost is split across these layers:

| layer | µs |
|---|---|
| kernel wrapper (`get_all_reduce_module` lookup, `comm.world_size`, result check) | 1.18 |
| `CustomAllReduceV2.custom_all_reduce` (byte count, `_pick_config` again) | 1.04 |
| `should_custom_ar` (`_pick_config`) | 0.62 |
| coordinator and `tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce` | 0.8 |

Every eager call of a given size and dtype resolves to the same algorithm and module, so the repeated work is redundant.

## Modifications

All changes are in `custom_all_reduce_v2.py`:
- Eager calls without `override_algo` resolve `(module, algorithm name, multicast)` once per `(nbytes, dtype)`. Both `should_custom_ar` and `custom_all_reduce` read that entry, and `custom_all_reduce` launches the module directly. A tvm-ffi Tensor result is still converted with `from_dlpack`.
- The cache is tied to the `config` object it was built from, so `uncap_pull_thresholds()` or any replaced config rebuilds it.
- Graph capture (`_graph_mode_allowed`), `override_algo` and kernel API logging keep the full path.

Callers, srt and diffusion alike, are unchanged. No memory is involved.

## Accuracy Tests

`test_custom_all_reduce.py --num-gpu 2` on 2xH200: 211 passed. Every existing case sets `override_algo`, so the tuned path had no coverage. Two tests are added:
- `test_custom_all_reduce_tuned_eager`: without an override, `should_custom_ar` matches `_pick_config` at every test size and dtype, and two passes (the second from the cache) equal NCCL exactly.
- `test_custom_all_reduce_eager_plan_follows_config`: replacing the config flips the verdict, restoring it flips it back, and the result equals NCCL.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Base `c15edf314d` + #44251, torch 2.14.1, 2xH200 (Xeon 8558P), with processes pinned to the GPUs' NUMA node.

**Host time per call** (µs, bf16 [1, 4096, 3072]; the GPU is kept busy so only submission is timed):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce` | 9.04 | 6.74 |
| `CustomAllReduceV2.custom_all_reduce` | 7.46 | 5.49 |
| `should_custom_ar` | 0.62 | 0.50 |
| bare module launch, for reference | 5.24 | 4.96 |

**End to end**, TP2 eager, client wall-clock median. Two identical co-resident servers differed by 3.5% in an A/A test on this box, so both paths were built into one server and chosen per request. Requests rotated through the arms in the same process, and an extra base arm measures in-process noise.

| | vs base (#44251 applied) | faster than base in | in-process A/A |
|---|---|---|---|
| FLUX.1-dev 512² | −2.43% | 11/12 | +0.33% |
| Qwen-Image-2.1 512² | −0.23% | 13/16 | 0.00% |
| both at 1024² (GPU-bound) | +0.1% | — | +0.0% |

Output images are unchanged: the same kernel runs with the same arguments.

On a base without #44251, the bypassed kernel wrapper also drops its DLPack re-wrap. Against plain main, this change measured −14.4% (Qwen-Image-2.1) and −15.2% (FLUX.1) at 512², 10/10 and 8/8. Most of that is the re-wrap that #44251 removes for every caller. The two PRs touch different files and combine cleanly.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -32,13 +32,15 @@
 import torch.distributed as dist
 from torch.distributed import ProcessGroup
 
+from sglang.kernels.kernel_api_logging import _KERNEL_API_LOG_LEVEL
 from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce import (
     AllReduceAlgo,
     Communicator,
     IPCManager,
     PullPlane,
     PushPlane,
     custom_all_reduce,
+    get_all_reduce_module,
 )
 from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import in_the_same_node_as
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs
@@ -190,6 +192,10 @@ def force_thresholds(heuristic):
             world_size=self.world_size,
         )._replace(num_pull_blocks=num_pull_blocks, num_push_blocks=num_push_blocks)
         self.override_algo: Optional[AllReduceAlgo] = None
+        # (nbytes, dtype) -> (module, algo name, multicast) or None, for
+        # eager calls under `_eager_plans_config`; rebuilt when config changes.
+        self._eager_plans: dict = {}
+        self._eager_plans_config = None
         # On a multi-node (MNNVL) group the symm-mem workspace plane works
         # across nodes, but graph zero-copy input registration (cudaIpc /
         # node-local VMM remap) does not — force eager pull inside graphs.
@@ -362,14 +368,44 @@ def should_custom_ar(self, inp: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
             return False
         if self.override_algo is not None:
             return inp_size <= self.max_size
+        if not self._graph_mode_allowed:
+            return self._eager_plan(inp_size, inp.dtype) is not None
         return self._pick_config(inp_size, self._can_use_graph()) is not None
 
+    def _eager_plan(self, nbytes: int, dtype: torch.dtype):
+        """The launch an eager all-reduce of this size takes, resolved once."""
+        if self._eager_plans_config is not self.config:
+            self._eager_plans, self._eager_plans_config = {}, self.config
+        key = (nbytes, dtype)
+        if key not in self._eager_plans:
+            config = self._pick_config(nbytes, False)
+            self._eager_plans[key] = (
+                None
+                if config is None
+                else (
+                    get_all_reduce_module(dtype, self.world_size),
+                    config.algo.algo_name,
+                    config.use_multicast,
+                )
+            )
+        return self._eager_plans[key]
+
     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
     # All-reduce
     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 
     def custom_all_reduce(self, input: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         nbytes = input.numel() * input.element_size()
+        if (
+            self.override_algo is None
+            and not self._graph_mode_allowed
+            and not _KERNEL_API_LOG_LEVEL
+        ):
+            plan = self._eager_plan(nbytes, input.dtype)
+            assert plan is not None, f"No config for {nbytes = }"
+            module, algo_name, use_multicast = plan
+            out = module.all_reduce(self.obj, input, algo_name, None, use_multicast)
+            return out if isinstance(out, torch.Tensor) else torch.from_dlpack(out)
         if self.override_algo is not None:
             # TODO: enhance this override pattern
             algo = self.override_algo

@@ -234,6 +234,64 @@ def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         torch.testing.assert_close(out_ref, out_jit, atol=0, rtol=0)
 
 
+def _eager_all_reduce(comm: CustomAllReduceV2, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    outs = []
+    for row in x.clone():
+        outs.append(comm.custom_all_reduce(row))
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    return torch.stack(outs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", TEST_DTYPES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("size", TEST_SIZES)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_custom_all_reduce_tuned_eager(size: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+    """Without an override, eager calls launch the tuned algorithm (cached per size)."""
+    nccl_group = _init_nccl_group_once()
+    comm = _init_comm_once()
+    comm.override_algo = None
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{int(os.environ['LOCAL_RANK'])}")
+    inp = torch.randint(0, 16, (TEST_LAYERS, size), dtype=dtype, device=device)
+    nbytes = inp[0].numel() * inp.element_size()
+    tuned = comm._pick_config(nbytes, False) is not None
+    assert comm.should_custom_ar(inp[0]) == tuned
+    if not tuned:
+        return
+    out_ref = inp.clone()
+    dist.all_reduce(out_ref, group=nccl_group)
+    for _ in range(2):  # the second pass runs from the cached launch
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            out_ref, _eager_all_reduce(comm, inp), atol=0, rtol=0
+        )
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_custom_all_reduce_eager_plan_follows_config() -> None:
+    """The cached eager launch is rebuilt when the config object is replaced."""
+    nccl_group = _init_nccl_group_once()
+    comm = _init_comm_once()
+    comm.override_algo = None
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{int(os.environ['LOCAL_RANK'])}")
+    inp = torch.randint(0, 16, (TEST_LAYERS, 1024), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    assert comm.should_custom_ar(inp[0])  # cached under the tuned config
+    tuned = comm.config
+    try:
+        eager = tuned.eager._replace(
+            one_shot_push_threshold=0,
+            one_shot_pull_threshold=0,
+            two_shot_pull_threshold=0,
+            mc=tuned.eager.mc._replace(min_bytes=0, max_bytes=0),
+        )
+        comm.config = tuned._replace(eager=eager)
+        assert not comm.should_custom_ar(inp[0])
+    finally:
+        comm.config = tuned
+    assert comm.should_custom_ar(inp[0])
+    out_ref = inp.clone()
+    dist.all_reduce(out_ref, group=nccl_group)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out_ref, _eager_all_reduce(comm, inp), atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     # Only sweep the common world sizes (2, 4, 8, 16) by default: testing every
     # count in 2..16 serially overruns the per-file CI time budget, and numbers
